articles.title: The Mona Lisa Vanished! And Now a Famous Composer Is Turning the Crazy True Story Into a Musical
articles.summary: Imagine the world's most famous painting just… gone! In 1911, someone swiped the Mona Lisa right off the wall. Now Andrew Lloyd Webber is writing a musical about the real-life heist and the two-year mystery that followed.

articles.title: Wait, Did a World Record Swimmer Just Have a Bad Race? Not So Fast!
articles.summary: Bobby Finke holds the world record in the 1500-meter swim, but last week he finished way slower than his best. Turns out, that's totally normal for him—his in-season times almost never predict how fast he'll go when it really counts.

articles.title: Before It Was a Treasure, the Declaration of Independence Was Just… News!
articles.summary: Today the Declaration of Independence sits behind bulletproof glass, but in 1776 it spread like wildfire through printed posters and public readings. A new book reveals how messy and exciting its journey really was—including the woman who bravely printed the signers' names.
